summary: Verified the fix for 'Failed to read the selected media' by testing the new web-image-picker (HTML <input type=file> + FileReader.readAsDataURL) across 3 flows. All picker flows succeeded without the error. Backend sanity 5/5. Non-regression on login and business-card save also verified.

integration_issues.flow: master-files -> Foto -> Scegli foto dalla galleria
integration_issues.issue: File chooser is triggered, no 'Failed to read' error appears; however the newly uploaded photo did not immediately show up as a file item (master-files-item count remained 0 after ~4s wait). This is likely either a slow POST /master/files or a state-refresh timing issue rather than the image-picker fix itself (the file was read into a data URL successfully — no exception was thrown). Worth a quick re-test by main agent to confirm the upload completes and the list refreshes.

action_items: OPTIONAL: verify that on /master-files after selecting a photo from the library, the file is POSTed and immediately appears as a master-files-item in the list (state refresh check). Not a blocker for the primary bug fix.
OPTIONAL: consider suppressing the transient 401 console errors observed while the auth token is being attached on cold page load (cosmetic — the retries succeed).
critical_code_review_comments: web-image-picker.ts is well-guarded: uses FileReader with onerror/onabort, has focus-fallback cancel detection, cleans up the DOM node, and defers dimension resolution to a non-fatal Image() probe. Robust for web use.

imagePickerCompat.ts correctly delegates to expo-image-picker via dynamic import() on native and to pickFilesWeb() on web. Result shape mirrors ImagePicker.ImagePickerResult so all existing call sites still work.

All 7 call sites (business-card, contact/new, contact/[id], appointment/new, master-files, chat/[id], my-thing) now import from @/src/utils/imagePickerCompat; static import of expo-image-picker is fully removed except in QRScannerModal (which has its own scanFromLibraryWeb path). ✅

One potential improvement (not a bug): when the same picker button is tapped and the user cancels, launchLibraryUniversal returns { canceled: true, assets: null }. Every current call site guards with `res.canceled || !res.assets?.[0]?.uri`, so cancel is handled correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the primary bug (3/3 tested picker flows produced a data URL with NO 'Failed to read' error)

seed_data_creation: Created /tmp/test_imgs/red.png (1x1 red PNG) used as the upload payload in Playwright expect_file_chooser flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The image picker on web is now driven by /app/frontend/src/web-image-picker.ts (native <input type=file> + FileReader.readAsDataURL) via /app/frontend/src/utils/imagePickerCompat.ts. To simulate a picker interaction in Playwright, use `async with page.expect_file_chooser() as fc: await el.click(force=True); (await fc.value).set_files('/path/to/img.png')`. TestIDs: business-card = bc-pick-logo; contact/new = photo-gallery / photo-camera; master-files = master-files-add-image (opens sheet) then mf-photo-library / mf-photo-camera / mf-video-library / mf-video-camera.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: on web, expo-image-picker (17.x) intermittently threw 'Failed to read the selected media' because the returned URI was a blob: URL and reading it via FileSystem.readAsStringAsync (native-only) or via expo-image-picker's own base64 helper on web failed for certain file types/sizes. Fix implemented by main agent: replaced expo-image-picker on WEB with a native HTML <input type=file> element created on-demand + FileReader.readAsDataURL() called directly on the File object. This returns a data URL synchronously in memory, never touching blob URLs. Verified across 3 flows — no 'Failed to read' error observed.
